title: Fasting
summary: A fasting timer built for multi-day fasts, on the Body tab.

stories.want: to see how long is left without opening the app
stories.soThat: I can get through the last hours

requirements.text: A fast's goal is one of `fasting.presets` or a custom length from 1 hour up to `fasting.max`.

history.text: A fast's goal is one of `fasting.presets` or a custom length up to `fasting.max`.

requirements.text: On Android a running fast shows a sticky notification with a live countdown, which keeps ticking after the app is swiped away or its process reclaimed.

history.text: On Android a running fast shows a sticky notification with a live countdown that keeps ticking while the app is killed.
history.reason: Version 1 said it survives the app being killed; a force-stop ends it.

requirements.text: On Android an exact alarm announces when the fast's goal is reached.
The fasting section shows lifetime records (longest fast, hours fasted, fasts done, goals hit) once a fast has been completed.

history.text: The fasting page shows lifetime records (longest fast, hours fasted, goals hit) and flags a new personal record as it happens.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: there is no fasting page, and the live flag is a separate requirement, FST-6.

requirements.text: A running fast shows which stage it has reached, by hours fasted.
A running fast longer than any before is flagged as it happens.
